           STRYCHNINUM PHOSPHORICUM

         Phosphate of Strychnin

        (STRYCHNIA PHOSPHORICA)


This drug acts through the cerebro-spinal system upon muscles, causing
        twitching, stiffness, weakness and loss of power; upon circulation, producing irregularity
        of pulse, and upon the mind, producing lack of control,   uncontrollable
        desire to laugh   and disinclination to use the brain. Very irregular pulse.
        Tachycardia. Rapid and weak pulse. Useful in chorea, hysteria, acute asthenia after acute
        fevers. Symptoms   worse   motion,   better
        rest and in open air. An excellent remedy in anæmia of spinal cord; paralysis; burning,
        aching, and weakness of spine; pain extends to front of chest; tenderness on pressure in
        mid-dorsal region; cold, clammy feet;   hands and axillæ covered
        with clammy perspiration  . Atelectasis and break in the compensation of a
        hypertrophied heart; the beginning of fatty degeneration of the heart muscle (Royal).



Dose.--  Third trituration.
